# **Ilhan Omar 's sister questioned as investigators pursue DNA evidence in fraud probe**
Rep. Ilhan Omar's sister, Sahra Noor, **[was voluntarily interviewed by federal investigators](https://substack.com/redirect/af788269-d31c-463d-8c83-4be43fe7c224?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after an Oct. 12 raid on Omar's D.C. home, though it is not yet known what she discussed with authorities.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/af788269-d31c-463d-8c83-4be43fe7c224?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Investigators reportedly obtained DNA evidence aimed at supporting allegations that Omar married her brother,** Ahmed Nur Said Elmi, in 2009 to help him obtain a green card, with sources saying evidence gathered may be sufficient to seek a grand jury indictment on conspiracy charges.

* **Border czar Tom Homan said officials have built a "strong case" potentially leading to Omar's denaturalization,** while her attorneys have accused the DOJ of violating search warrant protocols and demanded seized property's return -- allegations the DOJ called false and a "publicity play."

* * *
# **Expanding network of far-left groups involved in Paris riots - New protests scheduled**
A Fox News Digital investigation **[identified 101 organizations across 13 countries](https://substack.com/redirect/07cf8d7b-a5c4-48e2-a864-344735d4f6b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , including the U.S., coordinating, organizing, or amplifying France's ongoing unrest, up from 54 found earlier in the week, with only one in three led by youth or student groups.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/07cf8d7b-a5c4-48e2-a864-344735d4f6b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New protests are planned for Oct. 24 ( "Acte II"), Oct. 31 ("Acte III"), and a coordinated European youth strike on Nov. 20** involving dozens of socialist, communist, and anti-war groups across countries including Germany, the UK, Italy, Spain, and Belgium, with organizing happening through websites and Telegram channels.
* **U.S.-based groups, including CodePink, BreakThrough News, and the Party for Socialism and Liberation** -- tied to China-linked funder Neville Roy Singham -- are amplifying the protests, drawing connections to broader anti-war and anti-capitalist causes, while academic Hatem Bazian linked the unrest to unrelated historical and geopolitical events, including the 2023 Gaza hospital explosion.
* **French authorities ordered curfews Monday night** in parts of Paris, Nice, Lille, and other cities hit by weekend rioting that began as school-condition protests but escalated into broader unrest over living costs, resulting in at least 2,400 arrests.

French counter-terrorism police **[arrested Hodei Docampo Ciarra](https://substack.com/redirect/3af01917-8f66-4c82-bef5-1045ef3ed80d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , a known "ultra-left" activist on the national terror watchlist, as authorities now say the Oct. 17 burning of Limoges City Hall was a premeditated arson attack rather than riot-driven destruction, carried out amid a 5,000-person protest.

Let me help jog your memory: remember this?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7995d8aa-3042-4187-af4c-baf3b474a723?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

After 42 years of Mitch McConnell, I couldn't agree more with 2013 Andy.
But he's already broken his own commitment to serve no more than 12 years in the House. He's already at _14 years_ and is running for more as Kentucky's next Senator.
If he had his way, Andy would be in the Senate into his eighties like his mentor Mitch.
They'll do whatever it takes to cling to power, while Kentuckians pay the price.
**Our families deserve new leadership that actually puts working people first.**
Everywhere I travel across Kentucky, folks share stories of how the broken status quo leaves them struggling while politicians look the other way. _We cannot afford to accept Andy 's failed approach any longer._

Peter, We’re up on the airwaves with our new ad! This one is about Pat’s fight to stop the Trump administration from building ICE detention facilities here in the Hudson Valley. Earlier this year, when the administration tried to build one in Chester, Pat rallied our community and forced them to back down. Now that Trump is trying again in Newburgh, Pat is fighting to make sure ICE NEVER builds a detention facility here. We’re proud of this one, but you don’t have to take it from us. Rachel Maddow called it “a new campaign ad from an aggressive young Democratic incumbent... who knows what time it is and knows what it means to capture the moment and where the voters are right now.” You can click below to watch. name: Abdul
subject: We'll get you trained and ready
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3658%2E251025%2EvXxWXO ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3658%2E251025%2EvXxWXO ]Abdul for US Senate

Hey friends,

Abdul here.

This campaign was never about putting me on a bus tour, on TV, or in a
seat in Washington and walking away. It’s about getting Money out of
politics, Money in your pocket, and Medicare for All. It’s about turning a
moment into a movement that delivers real results for all of us.

Between now and November 3rd, we’ve got a lot of work to do. At the door.
On the phone. We have to talk to our neighbors about what’s at stake,
secure those votes, and make sure people turn in their ballots. Because it
shouldn’t be this hard to afford a second bag of groceries. It shouldn’t
be this hard to see a doctor. And it shouldn’t be this hard to pay your
taxes and know that money is going to your kids and your schools — not
bombing kids’ schools in other countries.

Mike Rogers is counting on us getting tired. He’s counting on outside
money, attack ads, and Michigan settling for another politician who cashes
the check and disappears. He thinks this Senate seat is something he can
buy. We know better.

Real Michigan voters and I want to talk about bringing down prices at the
gas station and the grocery store, getting guaranteed healthcare for
everyone, and building new schools for our kids here instead of bombing
them elsewhere.

Over the next couple weeks, this work gets intense. But if we buckle down
right now, we have a clear shot at making history. We’ve got the best team
— and we’re all on the same page — so it’s just about the effort we put
in.

That’s why I’m asking you to step up (or step back up) and volunteer.

Whether you can knock doors, make calls, send texts, or help get out the
vote another way, there’s a role for you. No experience needed — we’ll get
you trained and ready.

Sign up for a volunteer shift
here: [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1619?t=1004&akid=3658%2E251025%2EvXxWXO ]https://go.abdulforsenate.com

Let’s leave it all on the field.

name: Morgan Stahr, United for Democracy
subject: Elon Musk, DOGE, and the Supreme Court
disclaimer_text: Paid for by United for Democracy
body:
The Court has agreed to hear a case deciding whether we find out what DOGE was really up to. | |
---
Peter, For the first year of Trump’s second term, Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) slashed and burned program after program, department after department. **They gutted the Department of Education. They fired thousands of federal employees. They did it all from a position of authority—and We the People knew almost nothing about who they were and how they were making decisions.** At the end of DOGE’s existence, we found out that a DOGE employee had stolen the personal Social Security records of millions of Americans, and planned to transfer the data to a right-wing organization. **The ensuing interviews with the young, inexperienced Musk toadies went viral, prompting serious concerns about whose hands our data and our valuable government programs were in.** Luckily, an ethics and accountability organization had already filed a FOIA request for information on who was a part of DOGE and what recommendations they were making. **The Trump administration refused to grant the request and argued in court that the people had no right to know about what DOGE was up to.** When the case made its way to the Supreme Court, they sent it back down—likely in the hopes that a lower court would make it go away and allow DOGE to stay secret. But now, it’s made its way back, and the captured Supreme Court has agreed to hear it. **Because this Court has no transparency, we have no idea when the case will be argued. One thing we do know? Elon Musk will be working overtime in the background with his billions, his Trump connections, and the extremists in the shadows to influence the Court to rule in his favor.** **That’s why United for Democracy is gearing up right now to fight for transparency and accountability in this case.** This democracy isn’t owned by billionaires and wannabe dictators. It’s owned by us, and we have to make it clear that we expect the Supreme Court to allow DOGE’s secrets to come to light. The cuts and decisions made by DOGE hurt millions of people immediately. They’ll continue hurting people for decades to come. We must know what exactly the department is trying to hide, so we can right their wrongs and hold them accountable. clean_body: Two weeks, Peter. That's all we have left until Election Day, and I have to tell you, it's hard to believe we're already here. Over the past several months, I've had the chance to talk with people across our district. I've heard their worries, their hopes for their families, and what they want to see from the people representing them in the other Washington. Those conversations inform the work I do and are why I'm giving these last two weeks everything I've got. Peter, this race is going to be close. We know that. But I also know what this team is capable of when we come together. So I'm asking you personally: Please chip in to help us reach as many voters as possible in these final 14 days. >> = I hope you know how grateful I am to have you by my side. —Kim | Paid for by Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress Contributions or gifts to Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress are not tax deductible. name: OnePA Team
subject: Demand that Senate candidates commit to protecting our earned benefits
body:
Let’s organize now to protect the benefits our families earned and demand that Senate candidates commit to making the wealthy pay their fair share. | |
---
Peter, **Our elders spent decades caring for our families, working in our neighborhoods, and paying into Social Security. They deserve to grow old with enough money to keep their homes, buy groceries, and live with dignity.** But if nothing is done, six years from now the Social Security trust fund will begin to run dry -- resulting in an automatic 22% across the board cut to our earned Social Security benefits. **All Congress needs to do is make the wealthy pay more of their fair share into Social Security, and we can not only protect our earned benefits, but expand them for current and future generations.** We carry that demand with us as we organize for this election. Every candidate asking for our votes should have to answer to the people whose labor keeps our communities going. That includes making a public commitment to protect every dollar of our earned benefits. We know wealthy donors have access to candidates. They can write enormous checks and count on someone picking up the phone. Our power comes from organizing our neighbors and making our demands impossible to ignore. **That’s why we’re joining people across the country to put every 2026 Senate candidate on the record. We’re demanding that they protect Social Security from benefit cuts and make the wealthy contribute more to its future.** [**Every Senate candidate running in this election will still be in office six years from now when the trust fund begins to run dry. Demand every 2026 Senate candidate tell us where they stand. Will they protect our earned benefits and tax the rich to strengthen Social Security, or will they allow an automatic 22% cut?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38uUhqClqdk-pCh73GD6bmn4YWv3xv4e_qaB3mJw1cGT6DMqj2PI2vWtHSw8nbV-kDDzGCjPauQ02WSBbpQq1k-FuXF0d82tqykCX3PPE8fjb8UMAqHZFXvAWcndIr-VGYk1Dnpb2FC3g5-ZiW63TF1VqpNMPMyQFBjaOIby5jqWNFlniRcdoz77vLrDFSTASgDHK8XbLFtz1VHGc7W1kw4OgxfjAnYR7kUTlhIGuiFSrLE21hRNOT-1UF2IIF4GjfrsLys2N1gQ6rYjbBqd15QU-WENI2iBIBO_dgha2OPEY-Q9D5EJ8Gj1oOsDZcgRA1-goKI2ZskB3KOqHVDz9rlalj6g6lEC_coSAhaxyeD0mRuaCPV4K3S0CCc7RrUAmq3NHgrKmlCiU_mJ_Q5qX_sN01crfifzf4H_wsCNE49GmVsWohD-ALcjR19MZL9Mvoz4IX9GB5bc7kwFooeoHcVoNdiCPA2kbvRwNyEs_2LWBHh0Kn_7tAlRREWFNPayvo/4v1/vzXoGe4ARAO1giY1W6h6ng/h0/h001.cpvJF4xeRhRF5rMycnbZ9FfAKW79_3tCrC5CZ-c3JEk) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38uUhqClqdk-pCh73GD6bmn4YWv3xv4e_qaB3mJw1cGT6DMqj2PI2vWtHSw8nbV-kDDzGCjPauQ02WSBbpQq1k-FuXF0d82tqykCX3PPE8fjb8UMAqHZFXvAWcndIr-VGYk1Dnpb2FC3g5-ZiW63TF1VqpNMPMyQFBjaOIby5jqWNFlniRcdoz77vLrDFSTASgDHK8XbLFtz1VHGc7W1kw4OgxfjAnYR7kUTlhIGuiFSjozbsBpT6KQpoYfxsrTZHsYedKn91Ue2eGneoiVei23vc2y7BAx_oPlwtRNeyJokgmo5Y0leBbzaJzuL-W6cRR9taILC9lAkKDRvpvPar5_zxuW-w64wjjRnAzjQnf5P1_cxAcgo2ArYtJMy3yPSlAmttbQCHPOpINjlnCJ1bzuJVkJt-KPSMydbLiI4k3hG8HdJMz9LqUVjRyIo9ZRzhcH8nPfLkRk9QJg-9wju9qmB1PBYi5v5jULNc6Y7IDGjClyNRQ5Y_2kWEYnVfd_HGg/4v1/vzXoGe4ARAO1giY1W6h6ng/h1/h001.QIowSK7EvDNkJKHvCCsF8nSxYvRgTQoQrxD_-uGl2xM)

**We pay into Social Security with every paycheck. But the annual cap on contributions lets anyone making over $184,500 annually stop paying Social Security taxes on wages above that limit. Elon Musk stopped paying into Social Security just hours into 2026 while millionaires stop paying in by early March.** Making the wealthy contribute more of their fair share would help extend the lifespan of the trust fund and protect the benefits our families depend on.
When politicians propose cutting those benefits or raising the retirement age, working people and retirees are the ones paying the price. Our elders would have less to live on. More workers would have to keep working through pain and exhaustion. Families would stretch already-tight budgets to support loved ones.
Our fight for racial and economic justice includes the right to grow older with security. Black workers and families who have faced generations of discrimination in wages, housing, and opportunities to build wealth deserve the full protection of the benefits they earned.
**At OnePA, we’re building the power to make our communities’ demands count before and after Election Day. Let’s use this moment to secure public commitments we can organize around and hold the next Senate accountable for keeping.**
[**Send your message today. Demand that every Senate candidate commit to protecting Social Security and making the wealthy pay their fair share.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38uUhqClqdk-pCh73GD6bmn4YWv3xv4e_qaB3mJw1cGT6DMqj2PI2vWtHSw8nbV-kDDzGCjPauQ02WSBbpQq1k-FuXF0d82tqykCX3PPE8fjb8UMAqHZFXvAWcndIr-VGYk1Dnpb2FC3g5-ZiW63TF1VqpNMPMyQFBjaOIby5jqWNFlniRcdoz77vLrDFSTASgDHK8XbLFtz1VHGc7W1kw4OgxfjAnYR7kUTlhIGuiFSnTVjnGgUKnQ2SmCB1r9OLVh16nl-5U_p77el4l6Qh5CSKbkUBIwFs9KfKacM98z2mMZgTBafIxB3nK7qXuT7_m4-VIcYhORZjI8kC7_qkmzXvkTwnYWvXsX69vrJPgd1zynHPeFJIJWKJmQrrnSv5GAdfclWrQOFNVkjFMUT9pdtzU3UJcBYAR8Akfw8_9NwtixXAAG3ayZEF0W72R5zE-yNcltg0kcrwb3yvr9ygOF9rrXKy4yh0y2Z7m_zcNQG4091YoXmBOIWb9fZMSdwZ0/4v1/vzXoGe4ARAO1giY1W6h6ng/h2/h001.-nxbDDKfc2ss62OXNnhB21_fw_6gQlbzwlDcf73GCYU)

clean_body: Let’s organize now to protect the benefits our families earned and demand that Senate candidates commit to making the wealthy pay their fair share. | | Peter, Our elders spent decades caring for our families, working in our neighborhoods, and paying into Social Security. They deserve to grow old with enough money to keep their homes, buy groceries, and live with dignity. But if nothing is done, six years from now the Social Security trust fund will begin to run dry -- resulting in an automatic 22% across the board cut to our earned Social Security benefits. All Congress needs to do is make the wealthy pay more of their fair share into Social Security, and we can not only protect our earned benefits, but expand them for current and future generations. We carry that demand with us as we organize for this election. Every candidate asking for our votes should have to answer to the people whose labor keeps our communities going. That includes making a public commitment to protect every dollar of our earned benefits. We know wealthy donors have access to candidates. They can write enormous checks and count on someone picking up the phone. Our power comes from organizing our neighbors and making our demands impossible to ignore. That’s why we’re joining people across the country to put every 2026 Senate candidate on the record. We’re demanding that they protect Social Security from benefit cuts and make the wealthy contribute more to its future. | | We pay into Social Security with every paycheck. But the annual cap on contributions lets anyone making over $184,500 annually stop paying Social Security taxes on wages above that limit. Elon Musk stopped paying into Social Security just hours into 2026 while millionaires stop paying in by early March. Making the wealthy contribute more of their fair share would help extend the lifespan of the trust fund and protect the benefits our families depend on. When politicians propose cutting those benefits or raising the retirement age, working people and retirees are the ones paying the price. Our elders would have less to live on. More workers would have to keep working through pain and exhaustion. Families would stretch already-tight budgets to support loved ones. Our fight for racial and economic justice includes the right to grow older with security. Black workers and families who have faced generations of discrimination in wages, housing, and opportunities to build wealth deserve the full protection of the benefits they earned. At OnePA, we’re building the power to make our communities’ demands count before and after Election Day. Let’s use this moment to secure public commitments we can organize around and hold the next Senate accountable for keeping.
